requirement: Every governed product must receive an explicit forecast method or deferred reason.
Comparable-product methodology is an approved forecast method.
Comparable forecasts must identify products used and the selection basis.
Direct-history eligibility must be distinct from total forecast eligibility.
Forecast outputs must disclose method, version, confidence, limitations, and evidence.
Forecasts must provide downside, base, and upside scenarios.
Identity and executable current-price failures must remain fail-closed.
Purchase authorization must remain separate from forecast generation.
Every material implementation requirement must map to policy, code, tests, production gates, and evidence.
Collector display universe must exclude cases, packs, bundles, and unsupported configurations.
Collector registry identities must reconcile to the active Collector model universe.
Collector direct-history quality must be certified before direct-history methods are used.
Collector products with unusable or insufficient direct history must be evaluated for comparable routing.
All governed Collector products must appear in the final method-routing output.
Pre-Collector methodology must use lane-specific history, scarcity, era, and liquidity rules.
Secret Lair methodology must distinguish drop, foil, bundle, IP, artist, print, and singles-value structures.
